mapping.draft_py:
# Mu Yanling, Celestial Wind. Loyalty abilities are ActivatedAbility(cost=Cost((CostLoyalty(d),)))
# in printed order, then the compiler's planeswalker carrier.
# [+1]: Garruk, Unleashed's "up to one target creature" MODIFY_PT with Beyeen Veil's "-N/-0"
#       (power DECREASE 5, toughness DECREASE 0) and "Until your next turn" = DurationUntilNextTurn.
# [-3]: Read the Tides' "Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands."
# [-7]: Burn Bright's "Creatures you control get +N/+N until end of turn" with Watcher of the
#       Spheres' "with flying" (KEYWORD_HAS FLYING).
plus1 = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostLoyalty(delta=1),)),
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationUntilNextTurn(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QAtMost(n=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=0)),
    }),
)
minus3 = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostLoyalty(delta=-3),)),
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QAtMost(n=2),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
    }),
)
minus7 = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostLoyalty(delta=-7),)),
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'duration': DurationEot(),
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QUnbounded(),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.KEYWORD_HAS, keyword=Keyword.FLYING),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=5)),
    }),
)
abilities = [plus1, minus3, minus7, *compiled]

clauses.clause: [+1]: Until your next turn, up to one target creature gets -5/-0.
[−3]: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
[−7]: Creatures you control with flying get +5/+5 until end of turn.

mapping.notes: The probe cannot reach -7 (5 loyalty) and ends only the current turn. Packs in mu_yanling/ pass: pack_plus1_opp_turn (still -1/4 on the opponent's turn), pack_plus1_ends (4/4 at your next turn), pack_minus7 (only your fliers +5/+5), pack_minus7_eot.

clauses.evidence: ability [0] target slot 0..1; LOYALTY 5 -> 6; e.g. opp_giant 4/4 -> -1/4 and no revert when your turn ends; no-target variant: only loyalty. Its end at your next turn is not in G1: packs mu_yanling_celestial_wind_3 (still -1/4 on the opponent's turn, attacks Mu for 0) and _4 (4/4 again on your next turn) pass; twins fail.

clauses.clause: [−3]: Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands.
clauses.evidence: ability [1] target slot 0..2; LOYALTY 5 -> 2; one target (yours to your hand, the opponent's to its hand), two targets (you: hand 5 -> 7), none.

clauses.clause: [−7]: Creatures you control with flying get +5/+5 until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: G1: 'ability [2] not activatable from battlefield: cost:loyalty:5<7'. Packs mu_yanling_celestial_wind_1 (your flier 7/7; your ground creature and the opponent's flier unchanged) and _2 (ends with the turn) pass; twins fail.
